title: Obama at a campfire tells Eddie Vedder to read The Three-Body Problem

tellings.quote: He was at a campfire with uh Obama and like everybody was kind of wasted or something and Obama and he was like, "Dude, I got to know like what's actually going on." And Obama goes, "Read the threebody problem."
It involves former President Barack Obama and Pearl Jam lead singer Eddie Veter drunk around a campfire.
tellings.difference: Told as the host's own narration and names Pearl Jam.
tellings.link_reason: Same anecdote: a drunk Obama at a campfire tells Eddie Vedder to read The Three-Body Problem.

as_told.title: Obama tells Eddie Vedder to read The Three-Body Problem

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story about Eddie Vedder, the lead singer of the band Pearl Jam, sitting drunk around a campfire with former President Barack Obama. According to Michels, Vedder asked Obama what was really going on, and Obama told him to read The Three-Body Problem, a science fiction novel about contact with an alien civilisation. Told this way, it would hint that a president knows something about aliens that he could only point to sideways.
